newsitem.title: CHINA: Stone raises HK$235 mln in share issue.
newsitem.headline: Stone raises HK$235 mln in share issue.

text.p: Stone Electronic Technology Ltd said on Friday it would issue 117 million new shares at HK$2.05 per share to independent investors, raising net proceeds of about HK$235 million.

The company also said that certain executive directors had agreed to place 18.9 million existing shares, or about 2.46 percent of Stone Electronic's existing share capital, to independent investors at the same price.

The proceeds of the new share issue are due to be used for future investments in computer related and other high technology industries and as general working capital, Stone Electronic said in a statement.
Stone Electronic shares closed at HK$2.425 on Thursday.
